pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.61-$0.84 per click (median $0.71), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.53-$0.70 (median $0.59); bidding $0.39 wins ~0% of page views, paying ~$0.39 per click (second price)
market price $0.63-$0.84 (median $0.71); bidding $0.45 wins ~1% of page views, paying ~$0.43 per click (second price)
market price $0.61-$0.87 (median $0.72); bidding $0.43 wins ~1% of page views, paying ~$0.41 per click (second price)

bid_strategy.rationale: Maximise conversions within the budget; the ceiling per host is the price that wins your 'balanced' share.
